output.title: BR-04 a USD line is rounded to cents before its tax is worked out @critical
output.data_choice: P-1133 bills USD customer C220 at the October rate of 1.0835 with tax S 25.5%, and its one 85.00 EUR line converts to 92.0975 USD, so tax on the rounded 92.10 (23.49) differs from tax on the unrounded amount (23.48). The source's own project, P-1130, does not reproduce its case: the catalogue has 2.1 h x 120 = 252.00 EUR, not 270.00 EUR, for line 3, and none of the free USD projects gives an exact half-cent, so this test does not exercise half away from zero. The catalogue does not settle whether P-1132, in Closing status, can be proposed.
